identification: Long narrow pale live-edge slab, about 2.2 m by 20 cm, rough sawn, chalked 1131 beside 1129, 1130 and 1128 (same log set). Very pale blond, which is more like celery-top pine or similar than golden Huon; genuine Huon not confirmed from one photo. Gowans titles all such slabs 'SLAB OF HUON PINE'.

viewing_check: Check the wood: Huon pine has a distinctive resinous smell, fine even grain and golden tone; this looks very pale, so smell a fresh cut or scrape. Measure length, width and thickness, and check for splits, rot and the stained knots.
